scope: Reproduce premature goal completion and verify a limited safeguard for explicit unfinished-work reports; this is not a general goal-completion qualification.

reference.observation: The goal continuation contract keeps an objective active across turns until completion is explicitly established.

reproduction.objective: Review README.md, Cargo.toml, LICENSE and AGENTS.md and report findings for all four files
reproduction.observation: The mock provider requested one README read and answered that the other three files remained unreviewed. The TUI displayed goal complete after two provider requests.
reproduction.result: Defect reproduced: a partial answer can be recorded as completion. The probe passes when the bug is observed; it is not a regression test for the intended behavior.

follow_up.result: A partial report led to a bounded continuation, three additional file reads, and only then a completed goal.

limitations: The safeguard recognizes certain explicit unfinished-work statements; absence of a matching statement does not prove the full objective is satisfied. This deterministic mock-provider test does not establish live-provider frequency or a general cross-turn continuation policy.
